critical_code_review_comments: Brand name is HTML-escaped before injection into both subject (sanitized) and body (via escape to '<b>Evil</b>') — XSS-safe against merchant-controlled company_name.

sendApiKeyCreatedEmail signature grew to 9 positional args (…, companyName, lang?); any legacy caller that passes only 7 args will now get 'your brand' as the fallback. Grep showed the regenerate controller passes 8 args correctly; worth considering a single options object in a future refactor to avoid positional-arg drift.

balanceFundingBreakdown correctly zeros network/exchange/conversion fees and tags the costItem note with 'SafeDeal balance' so the UI/receipt can explain the delta vs. a normal checkout; computeFeeBreakdown honors lockedCosts over fromBalance (good: a deal that was already funded on-chain can't be retroactively re-priced if later reopened from balance).
